title: Mansa Devi: The Flower of Pride

scenes.visual: Champaknagar courtyard; Chand grips a gold staff beneath carved pillars.
Mansa appears in emerald and gold, cobra hoods fanned behind her.
Chand strikes the stone; impact flashes into a symbolic serpent-shadow.
scenes.camera: Sharp impact cut and brief hold.

scenes.visual: Oil-lit iron wedding chamber; a serpent slips through a tiny gap and Lakhindar falls still.
scenes.camera: Slow lateral move; no graphic detail.

scenes.visual: Behula kneels beside Lakhindar, grief hardening into resolve; red bridal fabric catches wind.
Behula's raft crosses a moonlit river as mist parts toward celestial light.
scenes.camera: Wide tracking shot with layered parallax.

scenes.visual: Luminous heavenly court; Behula dances devotionally before Mansa as lotus petals drift.
scenes.camera: Graceful orbit, hold on Mansa's softened expression.

scenes.visual: Ships rise, Lakhindar stirs, and Chand offers a lotus with his left hand; end on falling petal and black.
scenes.camera: Brief restoration montage, then still lotus close-up.
